title: Owner-facing alert error codes: contract, allowlist, email and in-app notification move together
answers: How do I add a new alert check error code?
Why does the alert check history show a generic error message?
Where is the alert error code allowlist?
body:
A new owner-readable errored-check code must be updated in several places:
- Define code and message in products/alerts/backend/judge/contract.py (e.g. `LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE`/`_MESSAGE`) and re-export via judge/__init__.py and facade/api.py `__all__`.
- Serializer allowlist in products/alerts/backend/presentation/views/alert.py `get_error`: codes not listed collapse to a generic 'check the alert configuration' message (raw errors may leak internals).
- Email: `send_notifications_for_errors` in posthog/tasks/alerts/utils.py sets template context (`provider_unavailable`) used by posthog/templates/email/alert_check_failed_to_evaluate.html.
- In-app: `dispatch_alert_error_in_app_notifications` in posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py branches on the code.
- Retry-exhausted errors get their code via `_failed_evaluation_error`, keyed on `error_type` (class name) that the workflow passes to `record_failed_evaluation`.
Tests: allowlist param in products/alerts/backend/tests/api/test_alert.py, email render in test_email_notifications.py.
applies: Adding or changing error codes on errored AlertCheck records.
